description:
Schedule or immediately publish a social media post. This is a DESTRUCTIVE WRITE that creates content on the user's real social accounts - once scheduled_at passes, it will be posted publicly and cannot be un-posted.

REQUIRED BEFORE CALLING:
1. Call `whoami` at the start of any new session to confirm which workspace and user you are acting for.
2. Show the user a preview containing ALL of: account(s) and platform(s), final caption text, scheduled time (in the user's timezone), media attached (if any), and workspace name.
3. Get explicit confirmation from the user (e.g. "post it", "yes schedule that", "looks good") BEFORE calling this tool. Do NOT infer consent from earlier instructions like "post about X every Monday" - confirm each individual post or the entire batch.
4. If scheduling multiple posts in one turn, list every post first and confirm the batch as a whole, then prefer `create_posts_batch` so they are created in one API request.

AFTER CALLING: Tell the user the post was created, include the posterly dashboard link returned by the tool, and offer the next natural action. Do not narrate raw HTTP, curl, or API plumbing.

Provide either account_id OR username+platform to identify the account. If scheduled_at is omitted, the post publishes immediately. If workspace_id is omitted, the server resolves one from the social account, falling back to the caller's default (personal) workspace - pass workspace_id explicitly if the user has more than one workspace.

MEDIA URLS: Posterly storage URLs are used as-is. Third-party HTTP(S) media URLs are copied into posterly storage before the post is saved, so API-created posts do not later fail on expired signed URLs. Short-lived signed URLs must still be live when this tool runs. You can also call `upload_media` with `url` first if you want to upload once and reuse the returned posterly URL across posts.

THREADS: Pass `thread_posts` (an array of 2+ strings) to schedule a multi-post thread on X (Twitter) or Threads (Meta). The first entry is the lead post; the rest are published as replies in the same chain. X entries are capped at 280 characters each (4000 for verified, 25000 for organization accounts); Threads entries are capped at 500 characters each. When `thread_posts` is set, `caption` is ignored.

X ARTICLES: To publish on X as a long-form Article, pass `platform_settings.article` ({ title, cover?: "first_image" | "none" }) for an X account. The caption becomes the Article body and is written as Markdown (headings, bold, italic, lists, quotes, code blocks, tables, dividers). Reference attached images with `![caption](media:1)`. Needs an X Premium account; polls, threads, paid partnership, video, and GIFs are not allowed with an Article.

PLATFORM SETTINGS: Pass `platform_settings` for composer-equivalent controls: Facebook story/reel/backgrounds, YouTube title/privacy/thumbnail/brandPartner, LinkedIn document titles/mentions/polls/content_call_to_action_label (including BUY_NOW and SHOP_NOW), TikTok direct-post privacy/toggles/commercial disclosure, Pinterest board/title/link/product_tags, GBP event/offer/CTA/recurrence, X reply settings/polls/paid_partnership, Threads reply controls/text attachments/ghost posts/spoilers/reply approvals/GIPHY, Telegram polls/buttons/video cover/live photo, Slack markdown/blocks, Mastodon visibility/quote/poll (media+poll allowed), and Instagram feed/story/reel/carousel/native media tags/collaborators/first comments/trial Reels/is_ai_generated/audio_id/caption add-ons. Instagram caption add-ons (`caption_addon`, or `poll_attachment` / `is_comment_prompt_used`) need a Facebook Login account, a non-empty caption, and a feed photo, Reel, or carousel parent. Stories are rejected. A poll and a comment prompt cannot be combined. For Instagram, @username in caption is only a caption mention; `user_tags` creates native media tags and `collaborators` sends co-author invitations only when the selected Meta-linked account reports those capabilities. Call `list_platforms` with `view: "schema"` and the account ID first. `instagram_settings` remains as a backwards-compatible alias.

TIKTOK AUDIENCE: TikTok posts publish directly, unless the account is set to Finish in TikTok app. With no `platform_settings.privacy_level` the account's saved audience is used, else public, and the response says which (`tiktok_audience_defaulted`): tell the person. `post_mode: "inbox"` sends the post to the TikTok app instead.

TIKTOK MEDIA: TikTok supports a single video or a photo slideshow of 1 to 35 images, never multiple videos. Image media auto-detects as a slideshow, so you usually do not set post_type or media_type for photos and every image is posted. Pass `platform_settings.media_type: "PHOTO"` to force a slideshow explicitly.

IDEMPOTENCY: If this call errors, times out, or the response is lost, retry with the same idempotency_key. If you omit it, an identical create within about 10 minutes returns the original post instead of a second one (deduplicated: true, original post id). When a result is unclear, call get_post or list_posts before creating again.

caption.description: The post caption/text content. On Instagram, @username is a caption mention, not a native tag or collaborator invite. Optional on Instagram Stories (first slide only in a series). Ignored when `thread_posts` is provided.

confirm.description: Must be true after explicit user confirmation of the post/account/workspace/schedule.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key (printable ASCII, 255 characters or fewer). Reuse it when a create errors, times out, or the response is lost. If omitted, an identical create within about 10 minutes returns the original post.

instagram_settings.description: Instagram-specific settings. If “tag” is ambiguous, distinguish caption @mentions (put @username in caption), native media tags (user_tags), and co-author invitations (collaborators). Native media tags work with eligible direct or Meta-linked accounts; collaborators require an eligible Meta-linked account. Call list_platforms with view=schema and account_id first.

audio_id.description: Licensed Instagram audio ID for Reels. Meta-linked Facebook Login accounts only.

caption_addon.description: Optional Instagram caption add-on. type is none, poll, or comment_prompt. A poll needs 2 to 4 options of 1 to 25 characters (an emoji counts as one) and the caption is the question. A comment prompt uses the caption as the prompt. Facebook Login only. Not available on Stories. At most one add-on per post. Pass null or type none to clear it.

collaborators.description: Native Instagram co-author invitations. Meta-linked accounts only; feed images, Reels, and carousels; not Stories.

is_ai_generated.description: Label the parent Instagram media container as AI-generated. For carousels, set on the parent only.

is_comment_prompt_used.description: Set true to attach an Instagram comment prompt. The caption is the prompt. Mutually exclusive with a poll. Facebook Login only. Not available on Stories.

is_poll_duration_extended.description: Set true only together with a poll, to request the longer Instagram poll duration.

media_accessibility.description: Preferred ordered media alt text. Identity follows index/asset_id through platform media preparation; media_alt_texts remains the legacy URL-map form.

poll_attachment.description: Instagram poll choices. option_a and option_b are required, option_c and option_d are optional, and option_d requires option_c. Mutually exclusive with a comment prompt. The caption is the question. Serialised JSON must be 200 characters or fewer.

user_tags.description: Native clickable media tags, not caption @mentions. Supported by eligible direct Instagram and Meta-linked connections; feed images, Reels/video, and Stories. Tags apply to each carousel item and the first Story in a Story Series.

media_url.description: Media URL to attach. Posterly storage URLs are used as-is; third-party HTTP(S) URLs are copied into posterly storage before the post is saved. Short-lived signed URLs must still be live when this tool runs. For threads, attaches to the lead post only.

media_urls.description: Multiple media URLs for carousel or multi-image posts. Posterly storage URLs are used as-is; third-party HTTP(S) URLs are copied into posterly storage before the post is saved. For TikTok, 2 or more images auto-create a photo slideshow (up to 35 images) and every image is posted.

platform.description: Platform name (required with username). Supported: instagram, facebook, tiktok, twitter, linkedin, youtube, pinterest, threads, google_business, telegram, bluesky, discord, slack, mastodon, devto, hashnode, wordpress, lemmy. Aliases such as x, gmb, and instagram-standalone are accepted.

platform_settings.description: Platform-specific settings for the selected account. Use this for non-Instagram settings and prefer it over raw metadata.

media_accessibility.description: Preferred ordered media alt text. Identity follows index/asset_id through platform media preparation; media_alt_texts remains the legacy URL-map form.

post_mode.description: TikTok delivery. auto publishes directly (default, unless the account is set to Finish in TikTok app). inbox sends the post to the TikTok app.

privacy_level.description: Who can see this TikTok when post_mode is auto. PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS, FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR, or SELF_ONLY. Optional: the saved default or public is used when omitted.

post_type.description: Optional post type: text, image, video, carousel, reel, story, story_series, document, photo, cover_photo, x_thread, or threads_thread. Omit it for auto-detection from media. For TikTok photo posts, use photo/image/carousel or omit it; for Facebook cover photos, use cover_photo or platform_settings.post_type.

scheduled_at.description: ISO 8601 datetime for scheduling (e.g. 2026-03-05T09:00:00Z). Omit for immediate publish.

thread_posts.description: For X or Threads only: array of 2+ strings, one per post in the thread. The first entry leads, the rest reply in order. When set, the platform must be twitter or threads.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to assign the post to (from whoami). If omitted, uses the account's workspace or the caller's default workspace.

name: create_post
